configurePresets.name: Debug
configurePresets.description: DEV debug build for the SBSFU bootloader slot: FLASH @ 0x08010400, VTOR 0x08010400. Full host control and the runtime preset lock; cannot store presets (Core/Inc/presets.h).

configurePresets.name: Release
configurePresets.description: DEV release build for the SBSFU bootloader slot: FLASH @ 0x08010400, VTOR 0x08010400. This is the image that gets signed. Full host control and the runtime preset lock; cannot store presets (Core/Inc/presets.h).

configurePresets.name: Debug-BareMetal
configurePresets.description: Standalone DEV debug build, no bootloader: FLASH @ 0x08000000. Stores presets in pages 110-125.

configurePresets.name: Release-BareMetal
configurePresets.description: Standalone DEV release build, no bootloader: FLASH @ 0x08000000. Stores presets in pages 110-125.

configurePresets.name: Debug-FDA
configurePresets.description: Presets-only: the presets are linked in, read-only. One preset at pages 108-109 (Core/Inc/presets/fda_preset.h), or a set (Core/Inc/presets/preset_table.h, the SDK's generate_preset_set). FW_PRESET_VARIANT (fda or test) names the set. The user config is read-only and host register writes are refused.

configurePresets.name: Release-FDA
configurePresets.description: Presets-only: the presets are linked in, read-only. One preset at pages 108-109 (Core/Inc/presets/fda_preset.h), or a set (Core/Inc/presets/preset_table.h, the SDK's generate_preset_set). FW_PRESET_VARIANT (fda or test) names the set. The user config is read-only and host register writes are refused.

configurePresets.name: Release-FDA-BareMetal
configurePresets.description: Release-FDA without the bootloader, for bench work. FLASH @ 0x08000000, the presets where Release-FDA links them.
